title: Article Deadline Scraper
description: Scrapes articles from websites extracting titles, links, deadlines, and published dates

titleSelector.title: Title Selector
titleSelector.description: CSS selector for article titles (within article container)

linkSelector.title: Link Selector
linkSelector.description: CSS selector for article links (within article container)

dateSelector.title: Date Selector
dateSelector.description: CSS selector for published date (within article container)

contentSelector.title: Content Selector
contentSelector.description: CSS selector for content area where deadlines may be found

maxRequestsPerCrawl.title: Max Requests
maxRequestsPerCrawl.description: Maximum number of pages to crawl

paginationSelector.title: Pagination Selector
paginationSelector.description: CSS selector for next page links

dateFilter.title: Date Filter
dateFilter.description: Only include opportunities posted within this time range

enableKeywordFilter.title: Enable Keyword Filter
enableKeywordFilter.description: Only include opportunities matching climate/startup keywords

useProxy.title: Use Residential Proxy
useProxy.description: Use Apify residential proxy. Only enable if you're getting blocked. Uses more compute credits.

googleSheetId.title: Google Sheet ID
googleSheetId.description: The ID of your Google Sheet (from the URL: docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/YOUR_SHEET_ID/edit). Leave empty to skip Google Sheets export.

googleSheetName.title: Sheet Name
googleSheetName.description: Name of the sheet tab to use (default: Sheet1)

googleCredentials.title: Google Service Account JSON
googleCredentials.description: Paste the ENTIRE contents of your Google Service Account JSON file here. Get it from Google Cloud Console → APIs & Services → Credentials → Service Account → Keys → Create JSON key
